description: Declarative Table-Driven FSM specification for Kardenwort GUI window lifecycle transitions. Defines all macroscopic frontend states, triggering events, guard conditions, resulting state transitions, and IO side-effect mappings required for deterministic cross-platform porting to Go and Rust.

states.description: Window is resting with no pending user modifications. All controls are fully enabled. Background workers are inactive.
User has made unsaved modifications. UI lock indicators are active. Save / Export controls become the primary action path.
A save operation is actively in progress. Most user controls are disabled to prevent concurrent edits during write.
Export-to-Anki or batch-export operation is actively in progress. Controls are locked pending export pipeline completion.
Background reprocessing worker (e.g., sentence-mode re-analysis) is running. The window remains visible but edit controls are locked.

events.description: User edits text content, triggering the dirty flag.
User clicks the Export / Send-to-Anki button.
Background reprocess worker is spawned (e.g., after config change).
Background save operation signals successful completion.
Background reprocessing worker exits with error.

transitions.description: User modifies content; window transitions from clean to dirty state.
Subsequent edits while already dirty remain in DIRTY state (idempotent).
User initiates save from dirty state; controls are locked during write.
Save completes successfully; window returns to clean idle state.
Save fails; window reverts to dirty state so the user can retry.
User initiates export from idle state; pipeline begins and controls lock.
User initiates export from dirty state; export proceeds without saving first.
Export pipeline completes; window returns to idle.
Export fails; window returns to idle and surfaces an error indicator.
Background reprocessing worker is spawned while the window is idle.
Background reprocessing worker is spawned while dirty; dirty flag preserved.
Reprocessing worker finishes cleanly; window returns to idle.
Reprocessing worker exits with error; window returns to idle and shows error.
